subject.title: [Bug]: Memory dreaming narrative/REM lane is given apply_patch and misuses it

question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin subagent tool-policy contract, such as `toolsAllow: []`, so memory-core Dream Diary can run prose-only without mutating tools?
rationale: Automation can see the missing path, but choosing the public SDK/protocol shape and the security semantics for plugin-owned subagent runs needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve plugin subagent tool policy
options.body: Add the typed SDK/protocol/gateway/agent plumbing and apply an explicit no-tools profile to memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs.

options.title: Use a memory-core-only internal workaround
options.body: Keep the public plugin API unchanged and add a narrower internal path only if maintainers do not want plugins to control subagent tool policy.

options.title: Accept current fallback noise
options.body: Leave the lane as-is if maintainers consider the low-frequency parse errors acceptable and do not want a new tool-policy boundary now.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin subagent tool policy
recommendation.body: Add the typed SDK/protocol/gateway/agent plumbing and apply an explicit no-tools profile to memory-core Dream Diary narrative runs.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged plugin subagent override work and the dreaming isolated-cron branch history make this the strongest routing signal for the API/security-boundary choice.
